answer: An adversary thus has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 25 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The lantern counter is kept in meadow and basalt exposes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 25 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1015 identities would post 3751 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
